title: Dynamical Modular Ground State and tau_* Selection

scope.frame: Upper half plane H and modular quotient ladder Gamma / <<T^N>> at maximal finite rung N=5
scope.object: derivation of tau_* = (1 + i*sqrt(84))/3 as the unique arithmetic geodesic apex of maximal word w = LLLLLRRLRLLR and stable dynamical minimum of modular effective potential V(tau) = E(tau, 3) - t_* E(tau, 2) (P-373, P-380, P-391)
scope.hypotheses: Modular group SL(2, Z); finite quotient ladder termination at N=5 (B1754); non-holomorphic Eisenstein series E(tau, s)

claim_one_line: DYNAMICAL MODULAR GROUND STATE AND TAU_* SELECTION (P-373, P-380, P-391): the finite modular ladder word w = L^5 R^2 L R L^2 R has SL(2, Z) matrix A = [[115, -32], [18, -5]] whose invariant geodesic semicircle has center c_0 = 1/3 (mod 1) and radius R = sqrt(84)/3, fixing the apex at tau_* = (1+i*sqrt(84))/3; at this point the modular effective potential V(tau) = E(tau,3) - t_* E(tau,2) exhibits radial stability with critical ratio t_* = 4.430013 lying inside the W154 stability window [3.205, 4.624] and positive radial curvature m_tau^2 = +17.113 > 0.
weave_or_thread: weave (arithmetic geodesic apex of maximal finite ladder rung and modular modulus stabilization)
